pages.title: Forgotten Weaponry
pages.text: Deep within Ancient City loot chests lie dormant sculk-infused weapons forged before recorded history.$(br2)While potent in their raw state, their true latent sword arts remain locked until exposed to the extreme dimensional energy of the $(5)Transmutation Cube$(0) and Cow King tokens.

pages.title: Weapon Ascension
pages.text: Combining these ancient blades with alchemical reagents grants unique active sword arts activated via $(6)Right-Click$(0). Each skill possesses distinct cooldowns, soundscapes, and tactical battlefield advantages.
